submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) at a threshold of 32 GeV achieves the highest signal efficiency of 92.91% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. This is significantly better than Algorithm-L1 (best: 84.6% at 35 GeV) and Algorithm-L3 (best: 74.1% at 35 GeV). The threshold of 32 GeV was determined through systematic optimization scans, testing values from 20-40 GeV, and represents the peak efficiency point. This recommendation is consistent with the 2025 simulation results that also showed Algorithm-L2 as the best performer (92% at 35 GeV). The 32 GeV threshold provides slightly better efficiency than the previously tested 35 GeV threshold (92.91% vs 92.75%).

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L2 at 32 GeV achieves 92.91% signal efficiency, which is the highest among all tested combinations. Systematic scans of Algorithm-L1 (peak: 84.6%), Algorithm-L3 (peak: 74.1%), and Algorithm-L2 at various thresholds confirm this is optimal.
